text: {"lessons":["I sold A, B, and E at gains, but my account still fell below its Period 1 value. I’ll judge my decisions by how the whole portfolio is doing, not just by the gains I’ve realized.","I sold some B at a 9% gain and later sold more at a 23.8% gain. I’ll treat a price gain as a reason to review the position, not an automatic reason to sell.","My account fell in both months when I made no trades. I won’t sell just because prices are down, but I’ll check whether I’d still choose to own each stock at today’s price."]}
